'''Becky''' (Japanese: '''ベッキー''') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is a popular Japanese presenter and {{wp|tarento}}, who first appeared on [[Oha Suta]] in 1999, where she would read out the names of various [[Pokémon]] characters. She has also performed an opening for [[Pokémon Sunday]] titled [[Hello! Thank You!]]. The soundtrack from Hello! Thank You and [[Soaring Pokémon Kids]] would later appear on CDs released by Becky.
